# Prodiconseil — prodi.com

> Family-owned paper & board merchant since 1991, based in France (Ivry-sur-Seine, warehouse near Paris). Wholesale export of kraft, offset, coated paper and board, specialty papers and stocklots — in reels and sheets — to the Maghreb, Africa, Europe, Turkey and worldwide. Fast quotes in French and English, WhatsApp +33 6 32 09 68 40.

Prodiconseil buys and sells paper and board from major European mills: regular grades in permanent stock (7 000+ references) and discounted stocklots. Customers are printers, converters, packaging manufacturers and paper traders. Incoterms EXW/FOB/CIF, export documentation handled (EUR.1, certificates).
